model.summary: Model favors CIN by 2.0 points (61% win chance). Biggest factors: Quarterback rating (CIN +3.2), Rest days (home minus away) (CIN +1.4), Offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (CIN +0.6). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 48.0 total points (BAL 23, CIN 25). Biggest factors: Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (raises total 2.9), Expected points from both teams' scoring (season blend) (raises total 1.2), Combined offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (lowers total 1.1). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
